expectation: Membrane-ring signal on rare scattered single cells (pDCs, a few CD123+ precursors), a small fraction of cells. They should sit as isolated cells or small clusters in stroma or lymphoid areas, with little signal on epithelium or tumour.
observed: A: several ROIs show sparse, discrete bright yellow cells (top row 3rd, 2nd row 3rd and 4th, 3rd row 4th). Other ROIs have diffuse yellow haze that follows the tissue architecture. B and C show grainy haze, no clear cells. D shows a few blobs at coarse pixel resolution.
why: Scattered discrete bright cells recur across independent ROIs as a rare pDC population would, but they sit on strong tissue-following haze, so contrast is low.
